context_definition: Input plus output combined; native window 1,048,576 tokens, with 64 serving safety tokens reserved.

method.native_path: Private GPU endpoint; real emitted tokens, natural EOS, uncached prompts; not the public accounting path.
method.per_stream_client_rate: Visible completion token count difference divided by time between first and last visible output.
method.aggregate_rate: Sum of actual completed output tokens divided by full measured phase, including fill and drain.
method.ttft: Use scheduled_ttft_p95_seconds for open-loop tests, including client admission queue time.
method.public_path: Isolated production auth/admission/accounting router. Initial full-router case is deliberately constrained to one CPU process at max_inputs=512; it does not match production CPU autoscaling.
method.full_length_caveat: 1M context smoke produced 4,096 tokens. Actual 350K output generation is not yet qualified.
